verdict.rationale: Trello documents a feature to "View work from Jira in a Trello list", and says Power-Ups can pull data from outside services into Trello. That brings one other project management tool's work into a Trello view, but the evidence covers only Jira. Nothing shows filtering to the engineer's assigned tasks or a single unified view across several tools. Missing for 10: documented aggregation across multiple PM tools beyond Jira, filtering to assigned tasks, any cross-tool 'my work' view, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view

citations.quote: View work from Jira in a Trello list
They can pull information and data from outside services directly into Trello, giving you clear perspective on your favorite tools for work.
